Final twelve-case production-hash suite passes independently; this historical finding remains unresolved.
remainingBlockers.confirmedScope: Real native Cloud Hazard collisions invoke FreezeInPlace through PlayerDeadFromHazard and recover camera/input on both clients. The exact old guest coordinate can trigger this path. The shared room gate now permits only a known hazard animation with recovery within 15 seconds; it never forces camera mode. The unique old host freeze source was not recorded and remains unconfirmed.
remainingBlockers.releaseRequirement: Identify the freeze source, distinguish a native transition from a persistent failure, and verify the resulting correction. Successful retries alone do not resolve this finding.

logGate: All probe modes install the shared runtime guard; all per-run .log files are scanned, including separate engine/Unity/guard logs. Required Unity logs and per-run binary artifacts must exist. Mod exceptions, HKMP ERROR, Spawn expired, native crash/access violation signatures and late .failed markers reject the run. Fourteen synthetic gate checks pass; line-based exception scanning preserves blank/timestamp boundaries without unbounded word backtracking.
